title: A biology-based quality-diversity algorithm for drug repurposing in Alzheimer's disease using automated machine learning.
summary: A biology-based GNN/AutoML quality-diversity search recovered known drug–gene links and prioritized a drug-repurposing candidate for Alzheimer’s disease. Experimental efficacy was not tested.
ai_technology: A biology-based graph neural network and AutoML quality-diversity search ranks drug-repurposing hypotheses.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Evaluation recovered known drug–gene links and ranked a candidate computationally; experimental efficacy remains unestablished.
evidence.unknown: External replication and real-world or clinical benefit were not established by the reviewed study; author affiliation is not stated in the reviewed material.
